name: defold
description: Make Defold games with Claude: version-matched Lua API and manuals, safe editing of .collection/.go/.gui files, validation after every edit, and build/run/logs/screenshot tools through the Defold editor or headless bob.

defold_path.title: Defold installation folder
defold_path.description: Folder that contains Defold.exe (or Defold.app/Contents/Resources) and the config file. Leave empty to auto-detect from the Defold editor's installations list.

hook_mode.title: Validation after edits
hook_mode.description: strict: syntax and schema errors in Defold files edited by Claude are reported back as blocking problems; warn: reported as notes only; off: no automatic checks.
